title: Closed-loop runtime overview
description: Pier-style local runtime product design: insight/decision, pains, layers, settled exits, day-1 path, defaults, acceptance.
alignsWith: Pier multi-agent CLI gold scheme v3 content model

gates.message: Need a one-screen BLUF (or decision) for the overview.
day1Commands must exist and stay ≤4 commands for learnability.
At least one closed loop with steps and exit states (or equivalent settled model).

dataShape.bluf: string — one-screen decision; may alias decision
dataShape.insight: string — why the design must be this way
dataShape.decision: string — optional alias of bluf for product spine
dataShape.phases: { wave, name, outcome, slices: { id, title }[] }[]

agentPrompt: Fill data.json for a closed-loop PRODUCT DESIGN overview. Required: bluf (or decision), hardConstraints[], closedLoops[] (or settled model), day1Commands[] (≤4), safetyRails[], acceptance[]. Write every string field in the user's language. Prefer insight + problem pains + defaults before→after. Quiet ≠ ready; no fake completed. Default expression is STATIC (tables + diagrams). Do not invent Play/Step demos. Content only — presentation owns navigation (overview/problem/design/path/landing). Default presentation is primary_nav_5.
